name: Zagori Cultural Landscape
description: Tucked into the Pindus mountains of northwestern Greece, Zagori is a patchwork of 46 stone villages, the Zagorochoria, spread across roughly 1,000 square kilometres. Each village gathers around a square shaded by a plane tree, with community-kept forests above. Arched stone bridges, cobbled paths and stairways still link them, winding through the Vikos and Voïdomatis river valleys.
